correctness.rationale: The proof is exact. Writing \(1+r=\int(1+\lambda)d\nu\) as the product of the square roots of the variance kernel and \(1-\lambda^2\), Cauchy--Schwarz gives \(\tau_g(1-s)\ge(1+r)^2\). Equality forces all spectral mass away from \(-1\) onto one point; solving the two moments gives the stated \(q\) and mass. The displayed symmetric four-state chain has eigenvalues \(-1\) and \(q\) on the two observable components and realizes every feasible pair. In the aperiodic class, positive \(-1\) mass forbids equality, while the recalibrated lazification preserves the target first two moments exactly and approaches the boundary. The package exact-rational checker independently exercises these identities.
